review_candidates.title: Trade Finance & Strategic Sourcing Lead-Acciona
review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 Mission: Lead the identification and development of strategic relationships with key suppliers, Export Credit Agencies (e.g., SINOSURE), and financial institutions in China. The main objective will be to negotiate framework agreements and design Trade Finance and international trade solutions that optimize commercial terms, mitigate risks, and secure Acciona's project value chain. Key Responsibilities: Scouting & Strategic Sourcing: Identify and develop new suppliers within the China & APAC markets for Infrastructure and Energy projects. Global Framework Agreements Negotiation: Lead the negotiation of long-term contracts with Chinese suppliers, ensuring the optimization of: o Contractual terms and conditions (EU, Australia, and South America legal frameworks). o Logistics & Incoterms: Define the risk transfer and international freight cost matrix, coordinating logistical feasibility with freight forwarders. o Commercial and payment terms (extension of payment terms and ECA support schemes). o Capacity, supply, quality guarantees (Inspection/Traceability), and after-sales service. o Financial risk mitigation, ESG criteria, and Compliance. Trade Finance & Supplier Financing Implementation: Design and execute complex payment structures, including Letters of Credit (L/C), Export Credit Insurance, ECAs (e.g., SINOSURE), and Supply Chain Finance (e.g., Structured Finance). Supply Chain & Financial Coordination: Act as the primary liaison between suppliers, Acciona’s internal teams (Finance, Procurement, Legal, Global Logistics), and external entities (local financial institutions, SINOSURE). Background & Experience Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher in International Trade, Finance, Business Administration, Engineering, or Supply Chain Management. Experience: o 5 to 10 years of experience in Strategic Sourcing, International Trade, or Supply Chain within high-demand sectors (Energy, EPC, Renewables, or Infrastructure). o Proven track record in managing and negotiating complex international contracts applied to large-scale projects. o Deep familiarity with Export Credit Insurance and International Settlement (L/C, D/P, D/A) — direct experience working with SINOSURE is highly preferred. o Proven history of successfully implementing supplier financing plans (Supplier Financing or Reverse Factoring). o Knowledge of International Logistics: Comprehensive understanding of ocean and land freight flows, customs clearance at origin (China), and coordination of heavy-lift or critical cargo. Technical & Personal Competencies: Languages: Bilingual or professional professional proficiency in Chinese Mandarin and English (mandatory). Spanish is a valuable asset. Corporate Finance & Accounting: Solid understanding of basic financial modeling (NPV), banking financing products (factoring, forfaiting), and familiarity with IFRS/GAAP standards to optimize financial statements (efficient management of accounts payable / DPO optimization). Sector Knowledge: Technical and commercial understanding of the infrastructure and renewable energy industries, with a specific focus on supply chains for photovoltaic plants (modules, inverters, trackers) and power transmission lines. Digital Skills: Advanced use of data analytics tools and AI. Soft Skills: High level of influence, commercial diplomacy for dealing with Chinese state-owned enterprises/institutions, and the ability to work effectively within complex, matrix, and multicultural organizations.

Brindar feedback, coaching y capacitación en técnicas de venta, argumentación, manejo de objeciones y cierre comercial. Asegurar una adecuada experiencia del cliente durante el proceso comercial. Requisitos Residir actualmente en Venezuela. Conocimiento y seguimiento de KPI de Call Center y ventas. Capacidad para analizar resultados y tomar decisiones a partir de indicadores. Experiencia realizando coaching, feedback y seguimiento de desempeño. Dominio de técnicas de venta, negociación, manejo de objeciones y cierre. Excelente comunicación verbal, léxico y capacidad de liderazgo. Organización, disciplina y orientación a resultados. Capacidad para trabajar bajo presión y gestionar desviaciones del equipo. Manejo de herramientas digitales. Manejo de Excel o Google Sheets para seguimiento y reportería. Experiencia utilizando CRM y herramientas de gestión de Call Center será altamente valorada. Capacidad para liderar equipos bajo modalidad 100% remota. Requisitos técnicos indispensables Computadora o laptop propia en buenas condiciones. Conexión estable a Internet. Audífonos o headset con micrófono. Espacio adecuado, tranquilo y sin interrupciones para trabajar. Capacidad para realizar reuniones y supervisión virtual.
